title: Cities of Refuge

questions.question: How many cities were the Levites given in total?
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:7 (ESV): "All the cities that you give to the Levites shall be forty-eight..."

questions.question: How many of these were Cities of Refuge?
What were the Cities of Refuge for?
options: For the manslayer who kills any person without intent to flee there
questions.correctAnswer: For the manslayer who kills any person without intent to flee there
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:11 (ESV): "That the manslayer who kills any person without intent may flee there."

questions.question: If a man strikes another with an iron object and he dies, he is a ...?
options: Murderer; he shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: Murderer; he shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:16 (ESV): "If he strikes him with an iron object... he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death."

questions.question: Who puts the murderer to death?
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:19 (ESV): "The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death..."

questions.question: What is required to convict a murderer?
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:30 (ESV): "But no person shall be put to death on the testimony of one witness."

questions.question: When can the manslayer (unintentional) return to his land?
options: After the death of the high priest
questions.correctAnswer: After the death of the high priest
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:25 (ESV): "And he shall remain in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed..."

questions.question: Can you take a ransom for the life of a murderer?
options: Yes, if he is a leader
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:31 (ESV): "Moreover, you shall accept no ransom for the life of a murderer... he shall surely be put to death."

questions.question: Blood pollutes the land. How is atonement made for blood shed?
options: Only by the blood of him who shed it
questions.correctAnswer: Only by the blood of him who shed it
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:33 (ESV): "For blood pollutes the land, and no atonement... except by the blood of the one who shed it."

questions.question: Where were the 6 cities located?
options: Three beyond the Jordan (East), and three in the land of Canaan (West)
questions.correctAnswer: Three beyond the Jordan (East), and three in the land of Canaan (West)
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:14 (ESV): "You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities in the land of Canaan..."

questions.question: How much pasture land around the cities for Levites?
If he pushes him out of hatred, is it murder?
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:20 (ESV): "And if he pushed him out of hatred... he is a murderer."

questions.question: If the avenger finds the manslayer outside the city of refuge boundary?
options: He may kill him without guilt
He is guilty if he kills him
questions.correctAnswer: He may kill him without guilt
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:27 (ESV): "And the avenger of blood kills the manslayer, he shall not be guilty of blood."

questions.question: Why must they not defile the land?
options: Because I the Lord dwell in the midst of the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Because I the Lord dwell in the midst of the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:34 (ESV): "You shall not defile the land... for I the Lord dwell in the midst..."

questions.question: Does the city of refuge protect a murderer permanently?
options: No, the congregation judges; if guilty, he is given to the avenger
questions.correctAnswer: No, the congregation judges; if guilty, he is given to the avenger
questions.explanation: Numbers 35:12, 24 indicates trial; if murder is proven, protection is lifted (implied v21).

key_verse_text: You shall not pollute the land in which you live, for blood pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
